card.name: First decimal digit in confidence intervals
card.fires_on: The first digit after the decimal point in a number, mostly the lower bound of a 95% confidence interval after a risk or odds ratio. It also fires on the first decimal digit of a percentage in trial results.

modes.label: Lower confidence bound
modes.description: The digit right after the decimal point in the lower limit of a confidence interval.
